newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC nickel mine remains closed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC nickel mine remains closed.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Friday its Rocky's Reward nickel mine near Leinster in Western Australia remained closed for a safety inspection after a miner was killed in a rockfall on Wednesday.

"At the moment a team is in place looking at exactly what happened," a WMC spokesman at the mine said. He could not say when the mine would reopen. The mine produces about 850,000 tonnes of ore per year, accounting for about 45 percent of the 30,000 tonnes of nickel metal produced at the Leinster complex.
The miner had been working at a depth of about 210 metres below the surface on Wednesday night when he was struck by rocks, prompting an immediate evacuation of the mine.
